page_title: REI 0-1 LIL | Reims v Lille 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Junya Ito (Reims) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
90+5' Lucas Chevalier (Lille) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+4' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lucas Chevalier is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+4' We are about to witness a substitution. Trevis Dago (Lille) is replacing Jonathan David.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) takes it short.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
89' Here comes a substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is brought on as a substitute for Amir Richardson.
88' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Chevalier intercepts the ball.
88' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Edon Zhegrova and he is replaced by Yusuf Yazici (Lille).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angel Gomes leaves the pitch and Alexsandro (Lille) comes on.
87' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
84' Will Still is stunned as referee Jeremy Stinat shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
83' Angel Gomes (Lille) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
81' That's the end of the game for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson, who is replaced by Ismaily (Lille).
79' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Keito Nakamura (Reims) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

77' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
74' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
74' Reims enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
72' Here's the change. Reda Khadra leaves the pitch and Keito Nakamura (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
72' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Teddy Teuma will be replaced by Oumar Diakite (Reims).
70' An attempted cross from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared.
70' Jonathan David (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
68' Jonathan David (Lille) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
67' Teddy Teuma (Reims) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
65' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' Will Still has decided to make a change. Sergio Akieme (Reims) replaces Thibault De Smet.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Therence Koudou departs the field of play to be replaced by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
62' Jonathan David (Lille) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

60' Tiago Santos (Lille) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Tiago Santos (Lille). This could have been a legendary goal.
59' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
56' 0 - 1 GOAL! Jonathan David (Lille) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
54' Junya Ito (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
53' None of the Reims players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
53' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mohamed Daramy (Reims) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
51' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
49' Teddy Teuma (Reims) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
48' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) for his blatant foul.
47' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to find Hakon Arnar Haraldsson, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Benjamin Andre (Lille) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
43' Lille hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
41' It looks like Tiago Santos (Lille) saw red with that tackle. Jeremy Stinat won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' The corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is hurriedly cleared.
38' Angel Gomes (Lille) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
38' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
37' Benjamin Andre (Lille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Teddy Teuma (Reims) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
33' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) rises high on the edge of the box to meet a cross and plants a powerful header goalwards, but Lucas Chevalier is alert and makes a decent save to deny him.
31' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
30' Amir Richardson (Reims) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
30' A cross from Mohamed Daramy (Reims) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
28' Angel Gomes (Lille) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
26' The linesman signals that Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
24' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
24' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
21' Jonathan David (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremy Stinat saw the whole situation.
19' Jonathan David (Lille) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save.
19' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Tiago Santos (Lille), but the defence gets it clear.
16' Teddy Teuma (Reims) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
14' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Angel Gomes (Lille) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' Angel Gomes (Lille) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
8' An indirect free kick, taken by Angel Gomes (Lille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
6' Therence Koudou (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

3' Lucas Chevalier makes a brilliant save! Reda Khadra (Reims) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
2' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Reims.
